_comment: Preset options for Settings -> Plugins -> Add source's dropdown. Purely a convenience list -- the free-text URL/ref fields work with any GitHub repo without it. Add an entry to grow the list, no code change or restart needed (this file is served as a static asset). Each entry: label (shown in the dropdown -- a name, not the raw URL), url (github.com repo), ref (branch/tag, default 'main' if omitted), description (optional -- shown as a hover tooltip on the option).
